$comment: Per-component deploy rules used by scripts/NtisDeploy.psm1. 'preserveFiles'/'preserveDirs' are never copied or purged on the server (robocopy /XF /XD with /MIR). Tenants can add more with 'preserveFiles' in tenants.json. 'configFiles' map ntis-configs/tenants/<tenant>/<env>/<from> -> <target root>\<to>; files missing in ntis-configs keep the copy already on the server.

ui.$preserveNote: server.js is preserved to match the current production deploy (cd-dynamic-deploy excluded it). The Next.js standalone server.js embeds next.config; remove it from this list once the servers are confirmed to run the unmodified standalone server.js.
